sections.label: Testing migrant workers in dormitories
sections.summary: Singapore has completed testing all migrant workers in dormitories and is progressively returning them to work safely.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Singapore has been fully engaged in this fight.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We have completed testing all the migrant workers in the dormitories and are progressively returning them to work safely.

sections.label: Economy shrinkage and government support
sections.summary: The economy will likely shrink by 5% to 7% this year, and the Government is injecting almost $100 billion to save jobs and support workers and companies.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Our economy will likely shrink by 5% to 7% this year.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The Government has acted decisively to save jobs and provide emergency support to workers and companies.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We are injecting almost $100 billion into the economy, including the latest package that Deputy Prime Minister Heng Swee Keat announced last week.

sections.label: Jobs as top priority
sections.summary: Jobs will remain the top priority for the next few years.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Jobs will remain our top priority for the next few years.

sections.label: National Jobs Council helping Singaporeans
sections.summary: The National Jobs Council is working with tripartite partners to create job and skills upgrading opportunities, including for lower wage, mature, and workers in their 40s and 50s.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The National Jobs Council is working closely with tripartite partners to create new job and skills upgrading opportunities for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We will continue to look out for our lower wage and mature workers, many of whom are also essential workers who have been keeping Singapore going during the crisis.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We are also making a concerted effort to help workers in their 40s and 50s, by matching them to suitable jobs and SkillsFuture programmes.

sections.label: Transforming economy and resuming air travel
sections.summary: There is urgency to transform the economy, resume air travel safely, strengthen digital connectivity, and help companies develop links to new markets.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: There is therefore great urgency to transform our economy and find new ways to make a living.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We will resume air travel safely, to maintain Singapore’s role as a global and regional hub.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We will strengthen digital connectivity and help companies develop their links to new markets.

sections.label: Reimagining city and green growth
sections.summary: Singapore will reimagine city planning, redesign urban mobility, grow using less resources in a low-carbon future, and push for green financing and sustainable infrastructure across the region.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We will reimagine how we plan our city, redesign urban mobility and grow using less resources in a low-carbon future.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We will push for green financing and sustainable infrastructure development across the region, to ride on Asia’s growth while protecting the environment.

sections.label: Support for every Singaporean
sections.summary: The Government will do more to support every Singaporean at each stage of life to build a stronger, more cohesive society.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: As part of this shift in social policy, the Government will do more to support every Singaporean, at each stage of life, to build a stronger and more cohesive society.

sections.label: Pathways and SkillsFuture upskilling
sections.summary: Many pathways are being developed so young Singaporeans can reach their fullest potential, and SkillsFuture will let every worker upskill and progress.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We are developing many pathways, so that young Singaporeans can achieve their fullest potential regardless of their starting point.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: And through the next bound of SkillsFuture, we will enable every worker to upskill and progress throughout their career, beyond their initial qualifications.

sections.label: Supporting vulnerable Singaporeans
sections.summary: It requires all Singaporeans' support and participation, and turns on helping vulnerable members through UPLIFT, KidSTART, disability training and jobs, and seniors' digital access.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: It requires the support and participation of all Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: It turns on how we look after our most vulnerable members, such as helping students from disadvantaged families through UPLIFT and KidSTART, providing training and job opportunities for people with disabilities and bridging the digital divide for our seniors.

sections.label: Job competition from work pass holders
sections.summary: Competition for jobs from work pass holders is a potentially divisive issue and a major source of anxiety, especially among mid-career Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Another potentially divisive issue closely connected to our Singaporean identity is the sense of competition for jobs from work pass holders.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: This has become a major source of anxiety, especially among mid-career Singaporeans.

sections.label: Fair treatment of Singaporean workers
sections.summary: The Government will work with employers to strengthen workforce capabilities and ensure firms treat Singaporeans fairly when recruiting or retrenching, with Singaporeans' interests paramount.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Our strong education system and training pathways have produced a workforce that can compete against the best in the world.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We will work with employers to further strengthen the capabilities of our workforce in every field, and ensure that firms treat Singaporeans fairly when they recruit or retrench workers.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: In all that we do, the interests of Singaporeans are always paramount.

sections.label: Designation of Leader of the Opposition
sections.summary: A significant change this term is the designation of the Leader of the Opposition, reflecting the larger number of Opposition Members in Parliament.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: One significant change in this term is the designation of the Leader of the Opposition, reflecting the larger number of Opposition Members in Parliament.

sections.label: Opposition proposing policy alternatives
sections.summary: The Opposition should propose policy alternatives for scrutiny and debate, besides raising questions and criticisms.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: In Parliament, besides raising questions and criticisms, the Opposition should also propose policy alternatives to be scrutinised and debated.

sections.label: Encouraging individuals to serve
sections.summary: This approach encourages able and committed individuals to serve, and Singapore should engage all people's aspirations and creative energies.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Only in this way will our system continue to encourage able and committed individuals to step forward to serve.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Ultimately, we want Singapore to evolve in a way that engages the aspirations and creative energies of all our people.

sections.label: Common purpose and readiness
sections.summary: Realising this strength requires a sense of common purpose and readiness to act on causes we care about.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: To realise this strength, we need a sense of common purpose, and a readiness to act to make a difference to causes we care about.

sections.label: Pioneers and pandemic crisis
sections.summary: Pioneers built Singapore against great odds; now we tackle a crisis of a generation that will define Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Our Pioneers prevailed against great odds to build Singapore and it is now our turn to tackle this crisis of a generation.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: How we respond to the pandemic and economic crisis will define Singapore for many years to come.
